title: Vedas – Rig, Sama, Yajur, Atharva
description: The Vedas are the oldest Hindu scriptures and are considered Shruti (divine revelations). They include the Rigveda (hymns), Samaveda (chants), Yajurveda (ritual instructions), and Atharvaveda (daily life prayers and rituals).

title: Upanishads – Philosophical Essence of the Vedas
short: Explores the nature of self and ultimate reality.
description: The Upanishads are philosophical texts explaining the essence of the Vedas. They discuss concepts like Brahman (supreme reality), Atman (soul), and Moksha (liberation).

title: Bhagavad Gita – The Song of God
short: A spiritual guide within the Mahabharata.
description: The Bhagavad Gita is a dialogue between Lord Krishna and Arjuna that teaches selfless action, devotion, and self-knowledge. It is one of the most important texts in Hindu philosophy.

title: Ramayana – Life and Ideals of Lord Rama
short: Epic of dharma, devotion, and righteousness.
description: The Ramayana by Valmiki narrates the life of Lord Rama, his devotion to dharma, the ideals of relationships, and the triumph of good over evil.

title: Mahabharata – Epic of Dharma and Karma
short: World's longest epic teaching dharma through conflict.
description: The Mahabharata tells the story of the Kurukshetra war and the moral dilemmas faced by its characters. It includes the Bhagavad Gita as a central teaching of life and duty.

title: Puranas – Stories and Moral Lessons
short: Narratives of deities and cosmic events.
description: The Puranas contain stories about gods, goddesses, creation, destruction, and moral values. They serve to make spiritual teachings accessible to the common people.
